x: Borobudur in Java, Indonesia, is the largest Buddhist stupa/monument in the world. Of the printed options, Kesariya (Bihar) is the largest stupa in India by height; Sanchi is the best known but smaller.
source: ASI Patna circle, Kesariya Stupa; NextGen AP History Part 2 (src/ap-history/ap-history-appsc-02.txt) p.11

dispute: Most keys for this question: Kesariya (ASI: largest/tallest excavated stupa). Strictly, Borobudur (Indonesia) is the largest Buddhist stupa-monument in the world, and NextGen calls Sanchi the largest in India.
